risk_note: RV2 overall (identity RV1 plus platform/validation's route-schema generator, RV2). GET/POST/DELETE /v1/me/tips leave planned (contract CT-15j). Reads and writes of app.user_tip_reads only by the token's app_id and uid; POST inserts with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (an existing row keeps read_at, read_at from the injected Clock); jump_tip needs a body {platform} checked in the handler against MarkTipReadRequest (missing → 20001 fields=[platform], extra fields → 20001); inviter_before_buy ignores the body and stores platform ''; DELETE removes only the user's jump_tip rows. Login 10001, version gate 10405, ban 10006 and rate limits come from the existing global guards. The generator gives an optional JSON request body no body schema (only markTipRead has one); routeSchemaOf and its frozen tests are unchanged. Frozen risk tests were adjusted beforehand by test-changes B1-02t (#518) and B1-02v. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
